description: ODC: the REFUSAL of the move of a static entity record. The reading order of the records is the value of the Order attribute (OrderByAttribute), not the position in the tree, and the move verb only reorders inside an ISequence of the parent; the kernel refuses and says which sequences the parent has. The proven alternative is to write the value of Order (set <record>/Order prop Value), as in tests/jobs-odc/static-entity-lifecycle.json.
expectError: move: IStaticEntity 'WfClaimStage' does not keep IStaticEntityRecord 'Closed' in an ordered sequence
